title: England await Guehi scan results after injury concern
snippet: Manchester City defender Marc Guehi will undergo a scan on a hip complaint on Sunday to determine whether he can report for England duty this week.
body: Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Guehi joined Manchester City from Crystal Palace in January Senior football correspondent Published 8 November 2026 Manchester City defender Marc Guehi will undergo a scan on a hip complaint on Sunday to determine whether he can report for England duty this week. The 26-year-old was substituted at half-time of City's loss at Nottingham Forest on Saturday and manager Enzo Maresca revealed afterwards the centre-back had requested to come off because of the injury. Maresca did not specify Guehi's issue, but it is understood he has been troubled by the hip problem in recent weeks. The fact he requested to be substituted has placed doubt over whether he will be available for England's Uefa Nations League matches against Croatia and Spain. Guehi will undergo tests, although it is likely England medical staff will also want to assess the player before a final decision is made. Thomas Tuchel will be hoping the defender is passed fit, with the former Crystal Palace captain a mainstay of his team since his appointment as England head coach in January 2025. Guehi started in all but one of England's games at the World Cup and all four of the team's Nations League fixtures in September and October. England face Croatia at Wembley on Thursday, 12 November, before travelling to Madrid to face World Cup winners Spain on Saturday, 15 November. Delap double helps Forest beat Man City for first home win More on this story Follow your club with BBC Sport
summary_en: Guehi is having a scan on a hip problem that could affect his England availability.

title: Manuel Neuer expected to be sidelined for six weeks
snippet:
At the age of 40 years and 225 days, Neuer became the oldest player ever to represent Bayern Munich in a Bundesliga match, surpassing the club’s previous record. \

The landmark appearance instead ended with another injury setback and renewed uncertainty over when Bayern’s long-serving No. 1 will ne
body: Manuel Neuer is expected to miss at least six weeks after suffering another significant foot injury during Bayern Munich’s 2-1 Bundesliga victory over Mainz on Saturday. Sky Germany reports that the 40-year-old is set to miss the remainder of the calendar year after being forced off shortly before half-time at the MEWA Arena. Bayern subsequently confirmed that Neuer sustained a partial tendon tear in his right foot, with the diagnosis established following an examination by the club’s medical department. The German record champions have not provided an official recovery timetable. According to Abendzeitung reporter Patrick Strasser , the best-case scenario would see Neuer return following the winter break in January. A longer rehabilitation period could keep the Bayern captain out until February. The latest setback is particularly concerning given Neuer’s recent problems with the same foot. The veteran goalkeeper had already missed matches this season because of persistent tendon irritation and only recently returned to action. The injury also arrives at a significant point in Neuer’s career. His current Bayern contract expires at the end of the season, and the 2014 World Cup winner has already strongly indicated that the 2026/27 campaign is likely to be his last as a professional . Speaking during Bayern’s summer training camp, Neuer suggested there was a strong likelihood that he would retire once the campaign concludes, having elected to continue for one more season becaus
summary_en: Neuer is expected to miss at least six weeks with a partial tendon tear in his right foot sustained against Mainz.
